title: Stan Meyer collection group killed
place_text: Michigan; United Kingdom; Orange County, California

tellings.quote: Stan Meyer guys, you know who those guys who got the Stan Meyer collection and that Toroid, all of them but one were killed.

plain: All but one of the men who got hold of the papers and devices left by the inventor Stan Meyer, including a ring-shaped device called a toroid, are said to have been killed. Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for UFO disclosure, tells it from what he was told, and he names an unnamed British lord as one source. The story touches Michigan, the United Kingdom and Orange County, California. Greer tells it as a sign that people are killed over energy technology.
